how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-coldridge-valley-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:170:obj:0: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
rows.quest:170:details:0: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, ⟦1⟧. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.
rows.quest:170:details:1: BI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.
rows.quest:170:details:2: BAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west!
rows.quest:170:details:3: BWe're a bit shorthanded here, ⟦2⟧, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
rows.quest:170:completion:0: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
rows.quest:179:obj:0: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
rows.quest:179:details:0: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?
rows.quest:179:details:1: BI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.
rows.quest:179:details:2: BI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
rows.quest:179:completion:0: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, ⟦3⟧, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
rows.quest:182:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
rows.quest:182:details:0: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of ⟦E2⟧ to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.
rows.quest:182:details:1: BFrom what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.
rows.quest:182:details:2: BPerhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
rows.quest:182:completion:0: Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!⟦4⟧<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>⟦5⟧A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
rows.quest:183:obj:0: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
rows.quest:183:details:0: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?
rows.quest:183:details:1: BThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.
rows.quest:183:details:2: BLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
rows.quest:183:completion:0: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:218:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
rows.quest:218:details:0: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.
rows.quest:218:details:1: BYou've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
rows.quest:218:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦7⟧! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.
rows.quest:218:completion:1: BAfter I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
rows.quest:233:obj:0: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.
rows.quest:233:details:0: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, ⟦8⟧? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.
rows.quest:233:details:1: BThey're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.
rows.quest:233:completion:0: Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...
rows.quest:233:completion:1: BUnfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to ⟦E1⟧. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
rows.quest:234:details:0: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
rows.quest:234:completion:0: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:282:details:0: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?
rows.quest:282:details:1: BHmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.
rows.quest:282:details:2: BSpeak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.
rows.quest:282:details:3: BFollow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
rows.quest:282:completion:0: Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to ⟦E2⟧ on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?
rows.quest:282:completion:1: BAt least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
rows.quest:420:obj:0: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
rows.quest:420:details:0: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.
rows.quest:420:details:1: BDirections? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.
rows.quest:420:details:2: BMake your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
rows.quest:420:completion:0: What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...
rows.quest:420:completion:1: BI told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!
rows.quest:420:completion:2: BNonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to ⟦E3⟧ as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.
rows.quest:420:completion:3: BI should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
rows.quest:3361:obj:0: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.
rows.quest:3361:details:0: We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong! Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:3361:details:1: BIn my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools. It was the trolls that got them. They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts! They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.
rows.quest:3361:details:2: BI'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
rows.quest:3361:completion:0: Huzzah, you've found them! You're an absolute savior, my friend. Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through! Thank you!
rows.quest:3364:obj:0: Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold in five minutes!
rows.quest:3364:details:0: Gah! I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first. I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!
rows.quest:3364:details:1: BYou look fast. Maybe you can make it. This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going. Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.
rows.quest:3364:details:2: BThanks, ⟦9⟧, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
rows.quest:3364:completion:0: Ah good, now this will hit the spot. Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
rows.quest:3365:obj:0: Return Nori's Mug to Nori Pridedrift.
rows.quest:3365:details:0: Now that hit the spot! Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.
rows.quest:3365:details:1: BHere ya go ⟦10⟧ - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
rows.quest:3365:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦11⟧! You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug. Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!
rows.quest:3365:completion:1: BHere's a little something for the effort. Thanks again for your help.
rows.quest:5841:obj:0: Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.
rows.quest:5841:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5841:details:1: BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Yori Crackhelm in Coldridge Valley. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:5841:details:2: BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5841:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦12⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E4⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
